blocks.h: Your URS or RFQ, answered line by line
blocks.intro: Send your user requirements specification (URS), request for quotation (RFQ) or tender. It comes back answered in your own numbering.

items.d: Every clause answered where you wrote it. Nothing renumbered, merged or skipped. Send your bid form with your RFQ.
items.label: Clauses

items.d: Meets, meets with a note, or differs. A line that does not apply says why.
items.label: Answer

items.d: Each answer names the document and page that shows it.
items.label: Proof

items.d: Every departure from your specification, with its reason. If there is none, the page says "none".
items.label: Departures

blocks.intro: Procurement checks these before award. Each is marked held, on request or in the questionnaire pack. Ask for any with your RFQ.

items.d: Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB), Ontario: status on request
Business number and sales tax account: details on request
Your form completed, or our questionnaire pack

items.q: Can you sign our contract form?
items.a: Yes, with exceptions named: our proposal lists any clause we cannot accept, once, with the reason. Send the form with your request for quotation (RFQ). Our standing positions are set out in your proposal.

Each package is built for one site, from your approved drawings, and its material is bought then. Any payment at that point is set out in your proposal. Every later payment follows an event you can check, such as a passed factory acceptance test (FAT).
Three conditions, all written in your proposal. Feed water stays inside the design basis, the daily log is kept, and changes are agreed with us first.

items.q: How do we place an order?
items.a: Make the purchase order out to [legal entity name] and quote our proposal number. Our bank details never change by email: check any such request with your Aquemi contact before acting on it.

items.q: What do you submit for a tender's experience or reference section?
items.a: Our bid answers it with the named team and its experience. It adds our quality system and audit access, specimen documents and a witnessed factory acceptance test (FAT). Tell us before the tender closes what the clause must prove. Written answer in a time confirmed when you enquire. References and site visits are arranged with our commercial lead during qualification.
